question: What further enclosure and writing should be done on an eight-petaled figure?
premises: An enclosure is made with hrīṃ syllables.
Writing is done again after this enclosure.
The writing is placed on an eight-petaled figure.
inference: After making an enclosure with hrīṃ syllables, one should write again on an eight-petaled figure.
plain_english: Having made an enclosure with hrīṃ syllables, one should write again on an eight-petaled figure.
